label: Bio-Rad CFX Manager / Maestro export
value_words: RFU, as the instrument software exported them

rawness.title: Baseline already subtracted
rawness.meaning: The instrument software subtracted a baseline before export. That weakens LinRegPCR's per-well efficiency, because it cannot see each well's own baseline. Re-export the raw fluorescence to restore it: in CFX Manager or Maestro choose 'No Baseline Subtraction' before exporting; from QuantStudio export Rn, not Delta Rn.

warnings.message: 96 reactions have no sample name; each such well is its own sample, named after its plate and well.

The amplification curves were most likely baseline-subtracted before export, so qPilot cannot estimate each well's baseline and efficiency itself. Re-export the raw fluorescence to restore per-well efficiency.
